subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool errors with included details be hidden before mutating-tool warning handling, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some exec detail warnings, while the PR asserts all exec-like warnings should be suppressed; automation cannot choose that user-visible policy safely.

options.title: Clarify and revise policy
options.body: Choose the intended exec-like warning contract, then update policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merge.

options.title: Preserve current detail visibility
options.body: Reject or narrow this PR if cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details should remain visible.

options.title: Accept suppress-all behavior
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally hide all exec-like warning payloads, but should require explicit test rewrites and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Clarify and revise policy
recommendation.body: Choose the intended exec-like warning contract, then update policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the mutation helper and payload warning path makes this the strongest routing signal for the policy choice.
